'''Advanced spread proton bombs''' were [[spread proton bomb]]s that were used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]]. They were upgraded to possess a more powerful explosive yield and radius within each cluster.<ref name="RS II" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
During a [[Mission to Prefsbelt IV|nighttime heist]] to the Prefsbelt IV [[Imperial Naval Academy/Legends|Imperial Naval Academy]], Wedge Antilles picked up several advanced spread proton bombs inside one of the hangars of the academy.
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Advanced spread proton bombs are weapon upgrades found in the [[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron (series)|''Star Wars: Rogue Squadron'']] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] series.
